publications.name: Heroes of Tarxon VI - Dindrenzi ORBATS
Heroes of Tarxon VI - Terran ORBAT

rules.name: Artillery Attacks
rules.description: All Terran Artillery Attacks use the Corrosive, Barrage and Scatter MARs.

rules.name: Artillery Dice
rules.description: Terran Forces use Artillery with 4D6 Attack Dice.

rules.name: Sky Drop Capability
rules.description: Initial Drop Site Markers are set to 5. Initial Artillery Markers are set to 5.

rules.name: Tactical Bonus
rules.description: Terran forces have a Tactics Bonus of +2.

rules.name: Additional Tactical Action Card
rules.description: A force containing this model may take an additional Tactical Action Card over and above the number stated for the game size.

rules.name: Primary Battle Tank
rules.description: Only the first Medium Battle Tank Squadron may get the Command Element (12") MAR per Helix.

sharedRules.name: Artillery Support (2)
sharedRules.description: May use the Artillery Support rules on Page 82.

sharedRules.name: Assault Vehicle
sharedRules.description: Models embarked may elect to activate immediately after the Assault Vehicle has finished its activation.

sharedRules.name: Bulky (2)
sharedRules.description: These units take up 2 slots in transports.

sharedRules.name: Command Element (12")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 12" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Command Element (16")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 16" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Command Element (8")
sharedRules.description: All helix squadrons in 8" gain an additional morale die when testing for disorder. If this model is detroyed all squadrons in the helix must take a disorder test requiring two successes.

sharedRules.name: Fearless
sharedRules.description: Unit never takes Disordered Tests.

sharedRules.name: Flying
sharedRules.description: When moving at Cruising Speed the unit gains Hard Target (-1), when moving at Flat Out the unit gains Hard Target (-2).

sharedRules.name: Hard Target (-1)
sharedRules.description: Main Ordnance is -1 to hit this unit.

sharedRules.name: Hit & Run
sharedRules.description: May shoot and move OR move and move. May not move Flat Out if this rule is used. When shooting then moving, the unit cannot take advantage of Target Locks or Specialist Fire Orders such as Overwatch or Focused Fire.

sharedRules.name: Logistics Points
sharedRules.description: May use up to 5 points to bid on an Opposed Tactics test.

sharedRules.name: Must Sky Drop
sharedRules.description: This squadron MUST deploy via Sky Drop (Page 79 of Core Rulebook)

sharedRules.name: Ordnance When Flat Out
sharedRules.description: This squadron may fire its Main Ordnance while moving Flat Out, but may only target Surface models. These shots are considered to be Rushed.

sharedRules.name: Rear Echelon
sharedRules.description: A model with this MAR is considered to be activated on the turn it is deployed.

sharedRules.name: Recon Specialist
sharedRules.description: May move in the Recon Phase.

sharedRules.name: Sky Drop
sharedRules.description: May use the Sky Drop Deployment rules on Page 79.

sharedRules.name: Sky Drop Nexus (1)
sharedRules.description: Places 1 Drop Site Marker in the Place Drop-Sites Segment of the Pre-Game Phase.

sharedRules.name: Strengthened Shields
sharedRules.description: All Terran Armoured Squadrons may re-roll any Initial Dice rolls of a 1 when defending with Shields. The second roll must be accepted.

sharedRules.name: Take & Hold
sharedRules.description: This unit may claim objectives.

sharedRules.name: Tracked/Wheeled Vehicle
sharedRules.description:
Impassable Terrain : Vegetation/Forests/Jungle, Huge Rocks/Spires, Rivers (Non Lethal), Walkway (Buildings Only).
May not Flat Out over Rough Ground / Craters.
Increase Movement by 3" on  Roads.

sharedRules.name: Transport (6)
sharedRules.description: May act as a transport for 6 slots worth of Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Walker
sharedRules.description: May not move Flat Out through Vegation or Rivers.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Anti-Personnel
sharedRules.description: Weapon ignores Hard Target rules when targeting Infantry.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Barrage
sharedRules.description: Models targeted by a Barrage weapon do not receive cover saves.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Corrosive
sharedRules.description: Models damaged by this weapon, but not destroyed receive a Debilitating Effect Marker. These markets give -1 DR until repaired. Multiple Markers may be placed, but the effect is not cumulative.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Interceptor
sharedRules.description: Flying targets do not gain the benefit of Hard Target against these weapons.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Nexus Designator
sharedRules.description: Weapon is used to reduce Sky Drop Markers micro dice.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Pinpoint (2)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 2d6. If one or more 6's are rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Pinpoint (4)
sharedRules.description: If a Pinpoint weapon damages, but fails to destroy non-infantry, roll 4d6. If one or more 6's are rolled, the target suffers an additional point of damage. If multiple weapons combine with Pinpoint, use the highest value only.

sharedRules.name: Weapon MAR:Terror Weapon
sharedRules.description: Disorder Tests caused by this weapon roll one less die.
